original_question: For a Hecke-Maass cusp form f of level 1 and fixed spectral parameter t_f, Good proved that the second moment in t has the form integral from 0 to T of |L(1/2 + it, f)|^2 dt = T P1(log T) + O_{t_f,epsilon}(T^(2/3 + epsilon)). Make the dependence on t_f in the error term explicit, determine whether the error can be made independent of t_f when T >= t_f^(3/2 + delta) for some delta > 0, and obtain the analogous statement for holomorphic Hecke eigenforms of weight k_f.
target_in_paper: Problem (14) in the Problems section: the question about Good’s second moment for a fixed level-1 Hecke–Maass cusp form and explicit uniformity in the spectral parameter.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper’s intended target very closely. It correctly identifies Good’s asymptotic for the second moment of L(1/2+it,f) for a fixed level-1 Hecke–Maass cusp form, correctly focuses on making the t_f-dependence in the error term explicit, correctly singles out the possible t_f-uniform regime T ≥ t_f^(3/2+delta), and correctly includes the request for the analogous holomorphic-weight statement.
missing_details: The paper explicitly says that P_1(x) is a polynomial of degree 1 in x.
To be fully stand-alone, the question should say that t_f is the spectral/Laplace parameter of f (so f has Laplace eigenvalue 1/4 + t_f^2).
It should specify that L(s,f) is the standard Hecke L-function attached to f.
The asymptotic is meant as T -> infinity with f fixed and epsilon > 0 arbitrary.
The uniformity subquestion should quantify that delta > 0 is fixed and ask whether the implied O-constant can be chosen independently of t_f throughout the range T ≥ t_f^(3/2+delta).

For the holomorphic analogue, the paper only asks for the corresponding statement for holomorphic Hecke eigenforms of weight k_f; the refined version should preserve that exact scope and not broaden to more general levels or families.
refined_question:
Let f be a fixed Hecke–Maass cusp form of level 1 with Laplace eigenvalue 1/4 + t_f^2, and let L(s,f) denote its Hecke L-function. Good showed that, as T -> infinity, one has
∫_0^T |L(1/2 + it, f)|^2 dt = T P_{1,f}(log T) + O_{t_f,epsilon}(T^(2/3 + epsilon)),
where P_{1,f}(x) is a polynomial of degree 1. Make the dependence of the implied constant on the spectral parameter t_f explicit. In particular, for each fixed delta > 0, determine whether one can choose the error term uniformly in t_f throughout the range T ≥ t_f^(3/2 + delta). Obtain the corresponding analogue for holomorphic Hecke eigenforms of weight k_f.
justification: The draft is essentially a paraphrase of Problem (14), which states Good’s asymptotic, emphasizes that the dependence on t_f in the O_{t_f,epsilon}(T^(2/3+epsilon)) term is not explicit, asks whether the error can be made independent of t_f in the range T ≥ t_f^(3/2+delta), and then asks for the analogous holomorphic Hecke-eigenform statement. Nearby Problem (11) supplies the paper’s local convention that P_j(x) denotes a polynomial of degree j and shows that parallel holomorphic-weight moment questions are part of the same tightly scoped cluster of problems.
